question: How many flat stones are piled up to play the game of Lagori? 🪨
explanation: Great job! In the fun game of Lagori, players stack exactly seven flat stones on top of each other! 🪨
hint: The game is also known as 'Seven Stones'.

question: What do players use to hit the pile of stones? ⚾
explanation: Awesome! Players use a soft ball to carefully aim and break the tower of stones! ⚾
hint: You throw it with your hands.

question: What is another popular name for the game of Lagori? 🎲
explanation: Super! Because we use seven stones, the game is widely known as Seven Stones! 🪨
hint: Count the number of rocks used.

question: What kind of stones are best for playing Lagori? 🪨
explanation: Brilliant! Flat stones are the best because they can easily sit on top of each other! 🪨
hint: They need to stack like pancakes.

question: How many teams play in a game of Lagori? 🤝
explanation: Great job! You need two teams to play: one team hits the stones and the other fields! ✌️

question: Where do children usually play the game of Lagori? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Lagori is a fun outdoor game, so it is played in a park or an open field! 🌳
hint: It needs a lot of open space.

question: What does the first team try to do to the stone tower? 💥
explanation: Super! The hitting team throws the ball to break the stone tower and scatter the stones! 💥
hint: They throw a ball at it.

question: Who tries to rebuild the stone tower? 🧱
explanation: Brilliant! After breaking it, the hitting team runs quickly to rebuild the tower to score a point! 🏃
hint: The team that threw the ball.

question: What must the fielding team do to stop the hitters? ⚾
explanation: Great job! The fielders pass the ball and try to hit the runners with it safely! ⚾
hint: They use the ball to get them out.

question: Where must the ball hit a player to get them safely out? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! To keep the game safe, the ball must hit the legs, below the knees! 🦵
hint: The lowest part of the legs.

question: What material is the ball usually made of to keep it safe? 🥎
explanation: Super! A soft sponge or rubber ball is used so nobody gets hurt while playing! 🥎
hint: It is very soft and squishy.

question: What word do you shout when you successfully rebuild the tower? 🗣️
explanation: Brilliant! You joyfully shout 'Lagori!' when you stack all seven stones back up! 🎉
hint: It is the name of the game.

question: How do players arrange the stones before starting the game? 🧱
explanation: Great job! The stones are stacked in a neat pile, one above the other! 🧱

question: Which stone goes at the very bottom of the Lagori tower? 🪨
explanation: Awesome! The biggest and heaviest stone is kept at the bottom to make a strong base! 🪨

question: Which stone goes at the very top of the tower? 🤏
explanation: Super! The stones get smaller as they go up, so the smallest stone sits on top! 🤏

question: How does playing Lagori help our bodies? 💪
explanation: Brilliant! Running, dodging, and throwing makes our bodies healthy, active, and strong! 💪

question: What do you need to do to hit the stones perfectly? 🎯
explanation: Great job! You must focus and aim carefully at the stones to break the tower! 🎯
hint: Look exactly where you want to throw.

question: What happens if the ball does not hit the stones at all? ❌
explanation: Awesome! If you miss the stones, you lose one of your throwing chances! ❌
hint: It is counted as a miss.

question: How many chances does a player get to hit the stones? 3️⃣
explanation: Super! Every player usually gets three turns to aim and hit the stones! 3️⃣

question: What do team members do to win the game easily? 🤝
explanation: Brilliant! Teamwork is the best way to rebuild the stones and win the match! 🤝

question: If a fielder catches the ball after it hits the stones, what happens? 👐
explanation: Great job! If the ball hits the stones and is caught directly, the batter gets out! 👐

question: What should the fielders pass to each other quickly? 🥎
explanation: Awesome! Fielders pass the ball fast to catch the runners who are building the stones! 🥎

question: How do players feel when they win the Lagori game? 😁
explanation: Super! Winning a fun outdoor game makes everyone feel very happy and proud! 😁

question: What is the most important rule when playing with friends? 🤗
explanation: Brilliant! Playing fairly and following the rules makes the game fun for everyone! 🤗

question: What happens if the fielding team hits the runner with the ball? 🏃
explanation: Great job! If the soft ball touches the runner below the knees, they are out! 🛑
hint: They have to leave the field.

question: What helps players dodge the ball easily? ⚡
explanation: Awesome! Running quickly and moving fast helps players dodge the ball! ⚡

question: Why do we put the biggest stone at the bottom? 🏗️
explanation: Super! A big stone at the bottom makes the whole tower strong and balanced! 🏗️

question: What should you do if your friend falls while playing? 🤝
explanation: Brilliant! A good friend and teammate always stops to help someone who has fallen! 🤝

question: What skill do we use when throwing the ball at the stones? 🎯
explanation: Great job! You need excellent throwing aim to hit the tower perfectly from a distance! 🎯

question: What skill do we use when avoiding the ball? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Moving quickly out of the way of the ball is a skill called dodging! 🏃‍♂️

question: Who tries to block the runners from the stones? 🧍
explanation: Super! The fielding team stands guard and tries to stop the runners from rebuilding! 🧍

question: How can friends protect the builder in Lagori? 🛡️
explanation: Brilliant! Teammates can bravely stand in the way to block the ball and protect the builder! 🛡️

question: What makes Lagori a very exciting game? 🤩
explanation: Great job! The fast running and dodging make Lagori an incredibly thrilling game! 🤩

question: Why is playing outdoor games like Lagori good for us? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Outdoor games give us fresh air, sunlight, and keep our bodies super healthy! ☀️
hint: We play outside under the sun.

question: What do we learn from playing team games? 🤝
explanation: Super! Playing together teaches us teamwork, sharing, and helping our friends! 🤝

question: What do players wear to run comfortably? 👟
explanation: Brilliant! Sports shoes grip the ground nicely and keep our feet safe while running! 👟

question: What shape are the stones usually in Lagori? 🥏
explanation: Great job! Flat pieces like broken tiles or flat stones stack the best! 🥏
hint: Like a coin or a plate.

question: How do we place the stones while rebuilding? ⬆️
explanation: Awesome! You have to carefully place them one by one to make a neat tower! ⬆️

question: Who is a champion in the game of Lagori? 🏆
explanation: Super! The team that plays fairly, scores the most points, and wins is the champion! 🏆
hint: The team that gets the trophy.

question: What is needed to run away from the fielders quickly? ⚡
explanation: Brilliant! Good speed helps you escape the ball and quickly build the tower! ⚡

question: What do we say to cheer for our team? 👏
explanation: Great job! We shout 'Come on!' or 'You can do it!' to encourage our friends! 👏

question: Why do fielders throw the ball at the runners' legs? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Hitting below the knees keeps the game completely safe and fun! 🦵
hint: It protects the face and body.

question: What makes the stone tower fall down? 💥
explanation: Super! When the thrown ball hits the stones hard, the tower crumbles down! 💥

question: Who gathers the stones after the tower breaks? 🏃
explanation: Brilliant! The hitting team must rush in quickly to gather the scattered stones! 🏃

question: If the hitting team rebuilds the tower safely, what do they score? 🪙
explanation: Great job! Stacking all seven stones and yelling 'Lagori' earns the team a shiny point! 🪙
hint: It adds to their winning score.

question: What kind of game is Lagori? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Lagori is an exciting traditional outdoor game played in open spaces! 🏃‍♂️

question: What happens when the whole hitting team gets out? 🔄
explanation: Super! When the hitters get out, the teams swap sides, and the fielders become the hitters! 🔄

question: What do we use to trace the circle for the stones? 🖍️
explanation: Brilliant! White chalk is great for drawing the throwing line and the stone circle on the ground! 🖍️
hint: You use it on a blackboard too.

question: How do we keep the score in a Lagori match? 📝
explanation: Great job! We keep count of the points on paper or in our heads to see who wins! 📝

question: What is the best part of playing Lagori? 🥰
explanation: Awesome! The very best part of any outdoor game is playing fair and having lots of fun! 🥰
